أستوضح (form X)

# أُسْتَوْضَحُ (ʔustawḍaḥu) /ʔus.taw.dˤa.ħu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
# أَسْتَوْضِحَ (ʔastawḍiḥa) /ʔas.taw.dˤi.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
# أُسْتَوْضَح
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
